_comment: Legacy atlases that modern Minecraft no longer reads at all, deleted AFTER the slice stage has cut them into gui/sprites/... . Membership criterion, checked per path against the version-pinned vanilla mirror (InventivetalentDev/minecraft-assets, 1.21.4): the path 404s, i.e. modern vanilla does not ship it, so nothing can load it from a resource pack either. Keeping them costs ~620KB in the M8SON pack (icons.png and the paintings atlas alone are 550KB) and confuses anyone reading the output. The prune stage NEVER deletes a path the slice stage wrote this run - three entries here (options_background, light_dirt_background, advancements/backgrounds/window) are also slicer copy() outputs, and that guard is what keeps them. Paths relative to assets/minecraft/.
